lines.trans: The interviews will take place in my office.
I want an agent with me.
We will choose the best candidate together.
Shall we start right away, Marteau?
No, I am not available.
Fine, with another candidate then.
Not before next week.
We have ten candidates in total.
You do three of them with me.
All right, I will do two candidates.
But I am the one who decides when.
Perfect, interviews in my office.
Here, have some coffee.

words.gram: imperative 2nd person singular used as interjection
